onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.subtitle: Choose your role and fill in basic information to continue.

role.title: Choose your role
role.text: Choose the role that fits you best. You can change it later.

profile.title: Basic profile
profile.text: Tell us a little about yourself so we can tailor the experience.

institution.title: Learning institution
institution.text: This step is optional, but it helps us tailor the teacher experience.

role.label: Choose role *
role.studentHint: For pupils, students and adults who want to learn independently or together with others.
role.teacherHint: Learning platform for teaching staff with classes, classrooms and digital whiteboard.
role.parentHint: For parents and guardians who want to support learning at home. Create your own study spaces and give adapted tasks.

studentAccess.title: How will you use 321school?
studentAccess.text: Choose what fits you now. You can open self study later if you need it.
studentAccess.spaceOnlyTitle: I have a code or link from a teacher
studentAccess.spaceOnlyHint: Use Spaces, assignments and content your teacher shares.
studentAccess.selfStudyTitle: I want to study on my own
studentAccess.selfStudyHint: Open the library, tools and your own practice activities.

errors.missingRole: Choose a role (Learner / student, Teacher or Parent / guardian).
errors.missingStudentAccess: Choose whether you have a teacher code or want to study on your own.
